_readme: Copy to secrets.json (gitignored), fill in, then `npm run secrets`. Private: never commit or sync it; back it up in a password manager.
DASHBOARD_KEY: a long random string, letters and digits only, e.g. from: openssl rand -hex 24
HA_TOKEN: long-lived token of a non-admin Home Assistant user (leave blank without Home Assistant)
GOOGLE_MAPS_KEY: optional: Google Cloud API key restricted to the Routes API, for live drive times (README: Calendars)

GOOGLE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT._note: optional: replace this object with the whole JSON key file of a Google service account (README: Calendars)
